chapter.verse: Amen. Tua hileh i Topa Jesu, a mi siangtho teng khempeuh tawh hong pai ciangin na lungsimte uh sianthona thu ah kiptak kilamin i Pa ahi Pasian' mai-ah a paubaanglo na hiding uh hi.

Tua ahih manin a tawpna ah sanggamte aw, Pasian' lungkim nadingin bangci gamtat ding cih ko' tungpan genna hilhna na ngah uh bangin, (tua bangin zong na hih mah bangun) tua bangin hih semsem un, ci-in Topa Jesu' sungah hong thumin kong hansuah uh hi.
A hang pen Topa Jesu' tungtawna kong gen kong hilh uh thute na thei uh hi.
A hang pen note a siangtho na hih nadingun Pasian' deihna hih bangin om hi: nulepa tatkhialhna peel un;
mi kim in nomau' pumpi tek sianthona leh manneihna tawh bangci kep ding cih thei un;
Pasian a theilo Gentile mite bangin na pumpi uh nulepa kilunggulhna tawh zang kei un;

hih thu ah kuamah in na sanggamte uh khembawl metbawl kei un. A hang pen note kong genkholh khitsa uh, zong khauhtak kong phawn khitsa uh ahih mah bangin hih thute khempeuh ah a thukkikpa pen Topa ahi hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh eite Pasian' hong sapkhiatna mun pen thanghuai gamtatna hilo-in sianthona hizaw hi.
Tua ahih manin hih thu a awlmawh lo mite pen mihing a awlmawhlo hilo-in note' tungah ama' Kha Siangtho a hong pia Pasian a awlmawhlo ahi uh hi.
Tu-in sanggam ki-itna vai ahihleh kuamah' laikhak ding na kisam kei uh hi. A hang pen khatlekhat a ki-it dingin note mahmah Pasian' hong hilhsa na hi uh hi.
Macedonia gamke mun citenga om sanggamte khempeuh' tungah zong tua bangin na hih uh ahi hi. Himah taleh sanggamte aw, tu-a zah sangin na hih semsem un, ci-in kong hanthawn uh hi.
Kong gen kong hilh ngei mah bangun a kamtawm, no' vai tek a hawm, nomau' khut tawh na a sem na hih ding uh lungtuppi-in nei un.
Tua hileh a pualam mite' mai-ah etlawmtak na gamta thei ding uh a, kitangsapna bangmah na nei kei ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin sanggamte aw, lametna a neilo midangte bangin na dah loh nadingun a ihmu mite' thu na theih loh ding uh kong deihsak kei uh hi.
A hang pen Jesu si-in thokik ci-in i upleh tua dan mahin Pasian in Jesu' sunga a ihmu khinsate amah tawh hong tonpih ding ci-in zong i um hi.
Topa' thupiakna tawh hih thu hong gen ka hi uh a, ei a hinglai mite, Topa' hong pai madong a omlaite, pen a ihmu khinsate sangin i masazaw kei ding hi.
A hang pen thupiak tangkona, vanmi mangpa' awging leh Pasian' pengkul tumna tawh vantung panin Topa mahmah hong kumsuk ding a, Khris' sunga misite hong thokik masa ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin ei a hinglai mite, a omlaite, huihlak ah Topa tawh a kimu dingin amaute tawh meii sungah thakhat thu-in hong kilatokhawm ding hi.
